manifest.description: Persistent project planning files with lifecycle hooks that inject selected plan context. Automatic recovery uses project files only. Explicit catchup modes may read same-project local session records to emit aggregate counts or bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation on capable hosts and never runs commands declared in Markdown. No network upload path. Installs across 60+ agents.
